title: CompactLineage
description: One page of an entity's lineage, slimmed to identity and relationship info, optionally narrowed to one column, with explicit markers for anything that was not returned.

compactLineageEdge.description: A lineage edge with both endpoints folded in by name, FQN and type.

fromFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the source entity.

toFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the target entity.

fromName.description: Display name (or name) of the source entity.

toName.description: Display name (or name) of the target entity.

fromType.description: Entity type of the source entity.

toType.description: Entity type of the target entity.

relationshipType.description: 'sql', or the pipeline that carries the edge as '<type>:<name>'; just '<type>' when the caller cannot view that pipeline.

pipelineFQN.description: FQN of the pipeline carrying the edge, when the caller can view it.

pipelineDescription.description: Description of the pipeline carrying the edge, when the caller can view it.

source.description: How the edge was recorded (for example query lineage or manual).

assetEdges.description: Number of asset-level edges this edge stands for.

sqlQuery.description: The transformation SQL, only when it was requested.

sqlTruncated.description: True when the returned SQL was cut.

hasSql.description: True when the edge has transformation SQL, whether or not it was returned.

tempLineageTables.description: Temporary-table hops parsed from the SQL, only when the SQL was requested.

updatedAt.description: When the edge was last updated.

columnsLineage.description: Column-level mappings on the edge, only when column lineage was requested.

edgeEndpoints.description: The two endpoints of an edge, identified by FQN.

fromFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the source entity.

toFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the target entity.

root.description: Fully qualified name of the entity the lineage is for.

rootId.description: Id of the entity the lineage is for.

rootType.description: Entity type of the entity the lineage is for.

upstream.description: Upstream edges on this page, nearest hop first.

downstream.description: Downstream edges on this page, nearest hop first.

totalEdges.description: Edges in the whole graph, across all pages.

edgesTruncated.description: True when this page does not complete the graph: more edges remain, or some were skipped as too large.

hasMore.description: True when more edges remain after this page.

nextFrom.description: Offset of the first edge of the next page, when more edges remain.

upstreamReturned.description: Upstream edges on this page, set when more edges remain.

upstreamTotal.description: Upstream edges in the whole graph, set when more edges remain.

downstreamReturned.description: Downstream edges on this page, set when more edges remain.

downstreamTotal.description: Downstream edges in the whole graph, set when more edges remain.

firstEdge.description: Offset of the first edge on this page.

oversizedEdges.description: The first few edges skipped because no response could hold them.

oversizedEdgeCount.description: How many edges were skipped because no response could hold them.

filteredEdges.description: Edges left out because the asset they lead to did not match the requested entity type or service filters.

columnUnmappedEdges.description: With a column requested: edges out of tables the column reaches that have no column mappings, left out because whether the column flows through them is unknown.

hiddenNodes.description: Nodes removed because the caller may not view them, or can only reach them through such a node.

hiddenNodesUnchecked.description: True when the graph exceeded the authorization limit and nodes past it were removed unchecked.

uncheckedNodes.description: How many of the hidden nodes lie past the authorization limit.
